texts.zh:
今天，我们的工程师和行星生态学家完成了位于[completed_ringworld_system.GetName]星系的环形世界最后一个宜居区间的建造。这个伟大的巨型结构的建造必将成为[Root.GetName]历史的里程碑。我们完成了屈指可数的文明才能完成的工作。

让这个环形世界成为一个永恒的见证：自从[Root.GetSpeciesName]物种从安全的母星踏足至如今，我们达成了什么样的成就。
texts.en:
Our engineers and planetary ecologists today finished the last of the habitat sections on the Ring World we built in the [completed_ringworld_system.GetName] system. The construction of this great megastructure must be considered a milestone in the history of the [Root.GetName] - we have accomplished what only a handful of civilizations in the history of our galaxy has managed before.

Let this Ring World stand forever as a testament to how much the [Root.GetSpeciesName] species has achieved since we first ventured beyond the safety of our homeworld's atmosphere.

texts.zh:
我们完成了位于[completed_ringworld_system.GetName]恒星系的环形世界宜居区间的建造，我们的工程师和生态学家又一次完成了不可能。

[Root.GetName]将被认为是全星系历史中最伟大的造匠之一。
texts.en:
We have concluded work on the habitat sections of the Ring World we built in the [completed_ringworld_system.GetName] system. Our engineers and ecologists have accomplished the impossible yet again.

The [Root.GetName] must now truly be considered one of the greatest builders in the history of the galaxy.

texts.zh: 我们收到消息[From.GetName]已着手在[ringworld_system.GetName]星系建造一个史诗级项目。他们旨在建造一个巨大的环形世界以环绕恒星系的恒星，作为项目的第一步他们开始将星系所有行星转换为巨型结构的金属骨架。
texts.en: Word has reached us that the [From.GetName] has undertaken a construction project of monumental proportions in the [ringworld_system.GetName] system. They intend to build a massive Ring World around the system's primary, and as a first step they have started to convert the matter of all nearby planetary bodies into an initial metal skeleton for the megastructure.

texts.zh: 我们收到消息[From.GetName]开始建造另一个环形世界，这次是在[ringworld_system.GetName]星系！和以前一样他们的工程师正在拆解星系的所有行星，用他们的资源和材料进行环形世界建造。
texts.en: We have received intelligence that the [From.GetName] is about to start construction on yet another Ring World, this time in the [ringworld_system.GetName] system! As before, their engineers are currently in the process of dismantling all planetary bodies in the system so that their resources and materials can be used in the Ring World's construction.

label.zh: 那个环会和我们的一样壮观吗？
label.en: Will it be as impressive as our own?

label.zh: 一项壮举，如果能完成的话。
label.en: An impressive project... if it is ever finished.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]完成了历史上屈指可数的文明才能完成的壮举——他们完成了位于[completed_ringworld_system.GetName]星系的巨型环形世界的建造。

这项科学奇迹将成为[From.GetSpeciesName]物种那举世瞩目的奇迹的见证，从默默无闻的开始以来他们一路走过了很久。
texts.en:
The [From.GetName] has accomplished what only a handful of civilizations in the history of our galaxy has managed before - they have finished construction of the colossal Ring World they were building around the primary star of the [completed_ringworld_system.GetName] system.

This technological marvel must be considered a testament to the impressive achievements of the [From.GetSpeciesName] species as a whole. They have certainly come a long way from their humble beginnings.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]完成了又一个环形世界的建造！这个壮观的巨型结构坐落在[completed_ringworld_system.GetName]星系，曾经这个星系的行星都以不见踪影，它们被拆解为建造用料。
texts.en: The [From.GetName] has finished another Ring World! This massive megastructure is located in the [completed_ringworld_system.GetName] system, which is now devoid of other planetary bodies since those that once existed were dismantled and used as building material.

label.zh: 也许我们也要考虑再建一些。
label.en: Perhaps we should consider building more as well.

label.zh: 又有一个？他们的资源用不完的吗？
label.en: Another one? Is there no limit to their resources?

texts.zh:
这些环绕着[ring_system.GetName]星系中央恒星的残骸，来自一个古老的环形世界。任何曾经存在于这个恒星系的行星体，都在这个庞然大物的修建工程中被作为建筑材料而使用。

没有证据能够指明这个工程奇迹最初是被谁修建的，但这一定是一个高度先进文明的杰作。
texts.en:
The shattered remnants of an ancient Ring World encircle the star of the [ring_system.GetName] system. Any planetary bodies that may once have existed here must have been used as building material during this megastructure's construction.

No evidence hinting towards who originally built this marvel of engineering has been found, but it must have been the product of a very advanced culture.

label.zh: 至少他们和我们的文明一样先进。
label.en: As advanced as we are, at any rate.
